about:
Ten ratings from Table 31.3 of the Spanish edition: concrete block walls sealed on at least one side, in five nominal thicknesses (90 to 300 mm) and two weight classes of block, lightweight ("Peso ligero") and normal ("Peso normal"). Each weight class prints the mass of one block and the sound transmission class. The thickness is the nominal one the page heads the first column with ("Grosor nominal, mm"), and the block mass is kilograms per block, which is not a surface density and is held in a field of its own.

The page prints the asterisk after the lightweight STC heading and its footnote, "STC = Clase de transmisión del sonido", which only expands the abbreviation.

rows.name: Pared de bloques de peso ligero
rows.group: TABLA 31.3. Valores STC para paredes de bloques normales y ligeros selladas al menos por un lado
rows.note: The name is composed from the caption and the column heading ("Peso ligero"); the page names the wall by its nominal thickness and the weight class of the block, and by nothing else.
